name: BonkDAO
rootCause: $19.3 million drained from BonkDAO in a pure governance attack. An attacker bought 1% of BONK, buried a treasury transfer inside a boring proposal, and passed it with 2.9% turnout. No code broke., no keys leaked, just crooked token-weighted governance voting math.
